profileLabel: Mixed economics; offsetting on institutions (low confidence)
summary: Santa Rosa City representative with 11 principal-authored bills. Authored an estate tax amnesty extension, travel-tax abolition, free professional exams for indigent examinees, an anti-dynasty ban, a postponement of barangay and SK elections and a bill fixing their terms. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: One extractor line, 'Emergency powers granted to the President' (HB09305), appears mis-described and was not scored. Evidence is a short list of widely co-sponsored bills.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored estate tax amnesty extension and travel tax abolition (+1 to +2), free professional exams for indigent examinees (-2); co-authored national minimum wage (-2).
